builds.name: Playful Peri
builds.desc:
This build aims to take advantage of Peri's good Atk stat by having her wield the Brave Lance+. It is the weapon of choice here, as it allows her to attack twice in succession, albeit at the cost of -5 Spd. Her Assist is Reposition, as he can use her high movement range to help propel her allies further across the map, or she can use it to get them out of danger. Her Special is Luna, as it has a charge of 3. The rhythm of Peri's attacks would line up in such a way where she can attack twice and defeat a unit, and then her next target will take one hit and be struck again after with Luna charged. This would have the same length as Moonbow, but since it has a stronger effect, it is more effective here. If the player does have the Quickened Pulse seal however, then Moonbow can potentially be an option since it would activate on the second strike.
Peri's A skill is Death Blow, as it grants +6 Atk upon initiating combat. Wielders of Brave weapons would only want to fight on the player phase anyway, and Death Blow would allow both strikes to hit even harder. Peri's B skill is either Lancebreaker or Hit and Run. Lancebreaker would allow her to perform quadruple strikes against opposing lancers, allowing her to break through them with her Special, while Hit and Run lets Peri retreat backwards one space after attacking, letting her regroup with her allies. Either skill has its merits, but it should be noted that Peri's Def is not the highest, meaning that if she exchanges blows with an opposing lancer, she may be in danger afterwards if she didn't outright destroy them in her first two strikes. Peri's C skill is either a cavalry buff or Def Ploy. Hone Cavalry in particular can help her more offensively oriented allies wreak havoc. However, the player can give Peri whichever cavalry buff is needed for their team. Given Peri's good Res stat, she can alternatively put Def Ploy to good use, allowing her to debuff her foes from a range for -5 Def, which would effectively let her do 10 more damage. Her Seal is Atk Ploy, which debuffs her foes for -3 Atk, which can help her or her teammates take a hit a little better as their enemies approach. Alternatively, if Moonbow is being used, Quickened Pulse can be her Seal, so she can activate Moonbow right away as outlined above.

builds.name: Brave Roy Except He's Blue
builds.desc: This build aims to take Peri's high Attack and Speed and turn her into an offensive powerhouse while at the same time lowering the drawbacks of Peri's low defenses using Galeforce. With the Heavy Blade seal, as well as the attack boost provided by Swift Sparrow or Death Blow 3, she has sufficient attack over most units to fully charge Galeforce, even against units which won't counterattack her thanks to the -1 charge provided by Slaying Lance. The Might upgrade is chosen to further enhance Peri's attack, however a +Spd Slaying Lance can be chosen instead to increase the amount of people she doubles, especially if you take Death Blow 3 over Swift Sparrow 2. Desperation 3 is chosen as a B-skill so that Peri may continue to deal damage to units who can counterattack her without further risk to her health, as she usually has sufficient attack to defeat most Red- and even some Blue-units. However, she will struggle against armored units, who have sufficient defense to deal with her offense, and will strike her back very hard. Buffs such as Hone/Goad Calvary provided by allies are welcomed greatly by her, increasing the amount of units who she can double and kill, and Fortify Calvary can help mitigate some of the damage of the initial strike. Ironically enough, the inspiration of this build, Brave Roy, makes for an excellent teammate for her as well, as the two of them can Goad Calvary one another and tear up an enemy back line, with Roy managing the greens that would otherwise be able to withstand Peri's onslaught. Mage units such as Reinhardt or Gunnthra can be fielded alongside her in order to defeat armored units, who typically have a low Res.

builds.name: Bruiser Peri
builds.desc:
With this build Peri is meant to run in and kill someone, and then be able to tank some hits. Peri has a good attack, speed, and res, and benefits from fury.
She should chose a weapon with a high mt. such as; Carrot Lance+ to counter Fury damage, Slaying Lance for special procs, or Berkuts Lance for the extra res. I chose not to go with a brave lance because with the additional spd from a spd refinement and Fury she gets over 40 spd and can naturally double.
Her B slot is pretty flexible. With this build she can tank a couple hits before shes out. With desperation she can keep fighting, and with vantage she can counter kill someone. Alternativly she can run a breaker skill for guaranteed doubles. This build doesnt require a calvary team to function, and can run Def ploy in a mixed team.
Attack +3 seal gives her that extra umph.

builds.name: Cold-Hearted Slayer
builds.desc: This build is meant for Peri's res to truly shine and synergise with her impressive Attack and Speed. Her Resistance is the core of the build. Though Berkut's Lance+ can definately go well Peri too, this build allows Peri to initiate her Glacies ASAP with Slaying Lance+ (Note: Refining the Slaying Lance+ is optional). This will work especially well on the Player Phase thanks to Warding Blow 3 and Threaten Def 3. Though she'd definately not a physical tank by any means, this is where the Close Def 3 and Swordbreaker 3 comes in. With the large amount of sword units out there, this allow Peri to rush through such problems. She's a glass cannon, so dont expect her to do well alone. But at the same time, don't let this Cold-Hearted doll catch you off guard.

builds.name: 2.0 D.C. Offensive
builds.desc: This build gives Peri a way to capitalize on her mobility, good res, and strong offenses to bait and remove mages from across the map. Atk IV with an Atk refined Slaying Lance gives her enough atk to take out just about every relevant red and blue mage, and several green mages, on counter. Reposition provides the most team support, but can be swapped out by the user's discretion. Glimmer provides the most consistent damage increase, being able to go off after every counter due to the reduced cooldown from Slaying Lance, while Aether provides higher score potential and longevity. Distant Counter is necessary for this build, giving Peri the ability to attack back after being hit from range. Quick Riposte allows the build to focus on increasing attack as much as possible by allowing Peri to double her opponent on enemy phase regardless of speed, thus not requiring significant speed investment to ensure doubles. Defense Ploy is chosen to soften up her targets from across the map, and is much more applicable than Threaten Defense. If Peri is being used on a cavalry emblem team, she can use any cavalry buff with success. The choice of Sacred Seal is dependent on whether the user values attack or survivability more than the other. Atk +3 is chosen to push Peri's Atk even further, ensuring more kills when combined with Quick Riposte and back to back Glimmer activations. Distant Defense allows Peri to survive stronger magic attacks, including the ever infamous Reinhardt, and even some dagger and non-Sacae's Blessing Brave Lyn bow initiations.

builds.name: 2.0 Budget Slayer
builds.desc: A budget Peri designed to go on the offensive. Fury/Desperation allow her to initiate and kill an opponent, while surviving and entering Desperation range. Glimmer is a very reliable special after the 2.0 update, and is on her by default. Either Attack or Speed +3 can be chosen as the Sacred Seal, for both contribute to her offensive capabilities.
